tbesh_html:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.1.1;
son of: Zuph (H6689);
father of: Elihu (H0453); also called Nahath at 1Ch.6.26; Toah at 1Ch.6.34;
§ Tohu = "lowly"
Levite, son of Zuph, father of Elihu, and great grandfather of Samuel

strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to depress; abasement;
